name: 30k-benchmark-specific-tr
description: A Turkish-language benchmark dataset of ~30k examples designed to evaluate model performance on language understanding and generation tasks specific to Turkish. It measures general language competence (e.g., QA/response generation) on in-domain Turkish content and is intended for evaluating Turkish NLP models. The dataset is optimized for benchmarking models' contextual understanding and generation quality in Turkish.
reputation: A niche, community-maintained Turkish benchmark with modest adoption within Turkish NLP research groups.
